serviceDetails.title: Why fit a new thermostat?
paras: An old dial thermostat in a cold hallway often leaves some rooms too hot and others too cold. A modern thermostat heats your home when you need it and saves energy when you do not. With a timer or a smart control, you stop paying to heat an empty house.
serviceDetails.alt: New thermostat fitted in a Watford home

serviceDetails.title: Which thermostat should I pick?
paras: We talk you through the options and help you choose:
list: Room thermostat: a simple dial or digital control for one temperature
Programmable thermostat: set different times and temperatures for each day
Wireless thermostat: no wires, so you can move it to the room you use most
Smart thermostat: control your heating from your phone, from anywhere
Smart radiator valves: control the temperature room by room
parasAfter: Not sure? Tell us how you use your home, and we will suggest the best fit for your budget.

serviceDetails.title: Can I control my heating from my phone?
paras: Yes, with a smart thermostat. Turn the heating on before you get home, switch it off from bed, or set a schedule from anywhere. We fit Hive, Google Nest and other brands, link the app to your phone and test it with your boiler. See our Hive and Nest pages for more on each.
serviceDetails.alt: Smart thermostat app controlling home heating

serviceDetails.title: Do you set the thermostat up for me?
paras: Yes. We wire in the thermostat, test the link to your boiler, set your schedule and temperatures, and walk you through the controls. If you choose a smart thermostat, we link the app to your phone before we leave. You do not need to read the manual.
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer wiring and testing a thermostat with a boiler

serviceDetails.title: Will a new thermostat work with my boiler?
paras: Most thermostats work with most boilers. Some smart features need a compatible boiler, and some older systems need extra wiring. We check your boiler and wiring first, and recommend a thermostat which works properly with your system.
serviceDetails.alt: Checking a thermostat works with an existing boiler

serviceDetails.title: Can you fit radiator valves too?
paras: Yes. Thermostatic radiator valves let you set a different temperature in each room, so bedrooms stay cooler and living rooms stay warm. Smart radiator valves go further and let you control each room from your phone. Many customers add these when they fit a new thermostat.
serviceDetails.alt: Thermostatic radiator valves fitted to radiators

serviceDetails.title: Where should my thermostat go?
paras: Your thermostat reads the temperature where it sits. In a cold hallway or next to a radiator, it gives a false reading, and the rest of the house ends up too hot or too cold. The best spot is the room you use most, away from draughts, direct sun and heat sources. A wireless thermostat makes this easy, as it can sit on a shelf or wall in any room.
serviceDetails.alt: Wireless thermostat placed in a living room

serviceDetails.title: Can you replace my old timer and thermostat?
paras: Yes. Many homes still have a separate timer on the boiler and a dial thermostat on the wall. We can replace both with one programmable or smart thermostat, which is easier to use and gives you better control over your heating.
serviceDetails.alt: Old heating timer replaced with a programmable thermostat

faqs.a: It depends on how you use your home and your budget. We talk you through simple dials, programmable, wireless and smart options and help you choose.

faqs.q: Can I control my heating from my phone?
faqs.a: Yes, with a smart thermostat. We fit Hive, Google Nest and other brands.

faqs.q: Will a new thermostat save me money?
faqs.a: It can. Better control means less heat wasted in empty rooms and empty hours.

faqs.q: Will a new thermostat work with my boiler?
faqs.a: Most do. We check your boiler and wiring first and recommend one which works properly.

faqs.q: Do I need wifi for a smart thermostat?
faqs.a: Yes. Smart thermostats use your home wifi to connect to the app.

faqs.q: Can you move my thermostat to a better spot?
faqs.a: Yes. A wireless thermostat can go in the room you use most, away from draughts and heat sources.

faqs.q: How long does a thermostat fit take?
faqs.a: Most fits take a few hours at most, including set up and showing you how it works.

faqs.q: Can you fit thermostatic radiator valves?
faqs.a: Yes. We fit standard and smart radiator valves for room by room control.

faqs.q: Where is the best place for a thermostat?
faqs.a: In the room you use most, away from draughts, radiators and direct sun.

faqs.q: Can you replace my boiler timer as well?
faqs.a: Yes. A programmable or smart thermostat can replace both your timer and your old thermostat.
